description: Reusable Agent Plugin workflows for GitHub organization security posture and repository CVE reachability.

parameters.description: Exclude repositories marked as forks when the graph has fork metadata.
parameters.name: exclude_forks

parameters.description: Maximum number of top vulnerabilities to inspect in detail.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Repository fullname to assess, as owner/name.
parameters.name: repo

parameters.description: Comma-separated CVE or GHSA identifiers to assess. Empty means assess the highest-severity open findings for the repository.
parameters.name: cve_ids

parameters.description: Maximum number of findings to assess in detail when cve_ids is empty.
parameters.name: max_cves

parameters.description: Severity filter for graph findings: critical, high, medium, low, or empty string for all.
parameters.name: severity

parameters.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA to inspect. Empty means the repository's default branch.
parameters.name: ref

repo-cve-exploitability.title: Repository CVE Exploitability Review
triggers: is this CVE exploitable in this repository
assess CVE reachability in the code
triage repository CVEs against the source
check if a dependency vulnerability is reachable

parameters.description: Repository to assess, as `owner/name` or a bare name.
parameters.name: repo

parameters.description: Comma-separated CVE or GHSA identifiers to restrict to. Empty means the highest-severity open findings.
parameters.name: cve_ids

parameters.description: Maximum number of findings to carry forward when cve_ids is empty.
parameters.name: max_cves

parameters.description: Severity filter: critical, high, medium, low, or empty for all.
parameters.name: severity

parameters.description: Repository fullname (`owner/name`) as resolved by the findings review.
parameters.name: repo

parameters.description: Optional. The CVEs to review — CVE id, package, severity, vulnerable range, patched and resolved version. Leave empty when the findings review's output is already in context; passing the list again costs a second copy of it and is not required.
parameters.name: findings

parameters.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA to inspect. Empty means the default branch.
parameters.name: ref

repo-cve-reachability.title: Repository CVE Reachability
triggers: is this CVE exploitable in this repository
assess CVE reachability in the code
check if a dependency vulnerability is reachable

name: github-security-investigations
